description.value: La Trattoria Italiana is a family-run Italian restaurant at Ruby Lake Resort on BC's Sunshine Coast, operated by the Cogrossi family from Milano with over 33 years of experience blending Northern Italian recipes with West Coast cuisine. The restaurant follows a farm-to-table philosophy, growing herbs and greens on-site and sourcing Ocean Wise seafood, with a focused seasonal menu of pasta, fresh seafood, and homemade desserts. Diners sit on a waterfront patio beside the lagoon or an upper patio overlooking Ruby Lake, inside a protected bird sanctuary where beavers, otters, and bald eagles are frequent sightings.

address.value: 15426 Sunshine Coast Hwy, Madeira Park, BC V0N2H1
